%=============================================================================
%  Shared resume preamble -- macros lifted verbatim from the original
%  main.tex so generated output is visually identical to the hand-written
%  resumes, and Overleaf still compiles it with plain pdflatex.
%
%  Do not edit the @@KNOB@@ lines by hand: build.py substitutes them while
%  hunting for a layout that fills exactly two pages.
%=============================================================================
\documentclass[letterpaper]{article}

%----- Packages ---------------------------------------------------------------
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[default]{sourcesanspro}
\usepackage[margin=0.55in, top=0.5in, bottom=0.5in]{geometry}
\usepackage{enumitem}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{hyperref}
% microtype is deliberately NOT loaded. With Source Sans it wants generated
% "--base" font instances for expansion and protrusion, and when those are not
% in the font map pdfTeX treats it as a *fatal* error rather than a warning --
% no PDF at all. Its benefit on a resume is negligible next to that fragility,
% and dropping it keeps one source compiling locally, in CI, and on Overleaf.
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{tabularx}
% Records the y position of the end of the content so build.py can measure how
% much of page two is actually filled, rather than guessing from page count.
\usepackage{zref-savepos}

%----- Base font size & leading -----------------------------------------------
\renewcommand{\normalsize}{\fontsize{9.60pt}{12.60pt}\selectfont}
\normalsize

%----- Colours ----------------------------------------------------------------
\definecolor{navy}{HTML}{1B3A5C}
\definecolor{lightgray}{HTML}{5A5A5A}
\definecolor{rulecol}{HTML}{B8C8D8}

%----- Hyperref ---------------------------------------------------------------
\hypersetup{colorlinks=true, urlcolor=navy, linkcolor=navy, pdfborder={0 0 0},
            pdftitle={Ashish Molakalapalli -- Machine Learning Engineer}, pdfauthor={Ashish Molakalapalli}}

%----- Section headers --------------------------------------------------------
\newcommand{\sectionrule}{%
  \vspace{0.5pt}{\color{rulecol}\hrule height 0.4pt}\vspace{3pt}}

\titleformat{\section}
  {\color{navy}\bfseries\fontsize{8.6pt}{10pt}\selectfont\MakeUppercase}
  {}{0em}{}
\titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{8.00pt}{0pt}

\newcommand{\rsection}[1]{\section{#1}\sectionrule}

%----- List style -------------------------------------------------------------
\setlist[itemize]{
  leftmargin=1.15em,
  itemsep=1.20pt,
  parsep=0pt,
  topsep=2pt,
  partopsep=0pt,
  label={\textcolor{navy}{\footnotesize$\bullet$}}
}

%----- No page numbers --------------------------------------------------------
\pagestyle{empty}

%----- Helpers ----------------------------------------------------------------
% #1 Role  #2 Organisation  #3 Location  #4 Dates
\newcommand{\entry}[4]{%
  \vspace{4.00pt}%
  \noindent
  \begin{tabular*}{\linewidth}{@{}l@{\extracolsep{\fill}}r@{}}
    {\bfseries\fontsize{9.8pt}{11.5pt}\selectfont #1} &
    {\fontsize{9pt}{11pt}\selectfont\textcolor{lightgray}{\textit{#4}}}\\[-1pt]
    {\fontsize{9.2pt}{11pt}\selectfont\textcolor{navy}{\bfseries #2}} &
    {\fontsize{9pt}{11pt}\selectfont\textcolor{lightgray}{\textit{#3}}}
  \end{tabular*}%
  \vspace{1.5pt}%
}

% Project header: #1 Name  #2 Stack
\newcommand{\proj}[2]{%
  \vspace{5.00pt}%
  \noindent
  {\bfseries\fontsize{9.6pt}{11.5pt}\selectfont #1}%
  \enspace{\fontsize{8.8pt}{10.5pt}\selectfont\textcolor{lightgray}{\textit{| #2}}}%
  \vspace{1.5pt}%
}

% Skill row: #1 Category  #2 Items
\newcommand{\sk}[2]{%
  \noindent
  {\bfseries\fontsize{9.2pt}{12pt}\selectfont #1:\enspace}%
  {\fontsize{9.2pt}{12pt}\selectfont #2}\par
  \vspace{1.8pt}%
}
